➡️ Hong Kong man loses HK$13 million in fake crypto investment app scam 

🌐 A Hong Kong man in his 70s has lost more than HK$13 million ($1.67 million) after a self-described cryptocurrency investment expert contacted him through WhatsApp and directed him to a fake trading app. The latest case began when the elderly man received an unsolicited WhatsApp message from someone claiming to be a cryptocurrency investment expert from Singapore. The person introduced him to what was presented as a crypto platform offering favorable exchange rates, low fees and withdrawals at any time.

‼️ Following the instructions he received, the man opened a cryptocurrency wallet and purchased Tether (USDT) and Ethereum (ETH). He was then told to download an investment application supplied by the scammer and transfer the cryptocurrency to designated wallet addresses as investment capital.

📣 Seeing his account balance rise inside the app, the victim became less suspicious and continued sending more cryptocurrency to the wallets provided by the scammer. The fraud only became clear when he tried to withdraw his funds and was repeatedly prevented from doing so under different pretexts. By the time the victim realized the investment platform was fraudulent, his losses had exceeded HK$13 million.

🔊 Iran hails Martyr Nasrallah as unique model of courage, foresight in confronting occupation

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has described former Hezbollah secretary-general Seyyed Hassan Nasrallah as a unique model of courage and foresight in confronting occupation.

The Foreign Ministry released a statement on Sunday to commemorate the second anniversary of Nasrallah’s martyrdom. It honored Nasrallah for his role and legacy in defending Lebanon, supporting the Palestinian cause, and confronting occupation.
​
The ministry also commemorated Martyr Nasrallah, Martyr Sayyed Hashem Safieddine, and other resistance figures who were assassinated, including Martyr Qassem Soleimani, Martyr Abu Mahdi al-Muhandis, Martyr Ismail Haniyeh, Martyr Yahya Sinwar, and Martyr Muhammad al-Ghamari, describing resistance against oppression and occupation as part of this school of thought.
​
The statement described Nasrallah, who led Hezbollah for three decades, as a model of courage, foresight, and strength in confronting the Israeli regime and its American supporters.
​
“Today, the people of Lebanon, the region and the world are experiencing more than ever the reality that confronting the occupation and warmongering of a racist and authoritarian regime that recognizes no limits in its crimes and brutality and honors no commitments or agreements requires the continuation of dignified resistance,” the statement noted.
​
The Foreign Ministry also strongly condemned the assassination of Nasrallah and his companions, including Brigadier General Abbas Nilforoushan, and stressed the need to prosecute and punish those responsible for and behind the attack.
​
The statement reaffirmed Iran’s support for Lebanon’s independence, territorial integrity, sovereignty, and national unity, describing a strong and independent Lebanon as one of the pillars of lasting stability and security in the region.
